## feature pairs and labels

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
```

USing [M+H]+ feature as anchor, assign labels only to the neibouger feature (e.g. 5s, 10s), assign 1 when both found peak matching in to library and also with annotation. label 0 means negative or unsure in semi-supervised learning. 

```{r}
# Step 1: Generate feature pairs and labels
 feature_pairs <- pairwise_features_labels(
  feature_table = result_StM16_FT_filtered,
  feature_compounds = direct_match_Stm16_res_MS1,
  rt_threshold = 10.0
)
```



## EIC similarity 
based on pre calculate feature pair with labels, we calcualte the pairwise feature EIC similarity

```{r}

           features = result_StM16_FT_filtered,
           eic_data = result_StM16[[4]])

```






```{r}
library(dplyr)


library(dplyr)

# Standardize the pair ordering: feature_1 always <= feature_2 (alphabetical)
standardize_pairs <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      f1 = pmin(feature_1, feature_2),
      f2 = pmax(feature_1, feature_2)
    ) %>%
    select(-feature_1, -feature_2) %>%
    rename(feature_1 = f1, feature_2 = f2)
}

pairs_for_ml_std <- standardize_pairs(pairs_for_ml)
rt_sim_res_std <- standardize_pairs(rt_sim_res)
Stm16_corintensity_std <- standardize_pairs(Stm16_corintensity)
cor_df_std <- standardize_pairs(eic_result@correlation_df)

# Now join
merged_input <- pairs_for_ml_std %>%
  left_join(rt_sim_res_std, by = c("feature_1", "feature_2")) %>%
  left_join(Stm16_corintensity_std, by = c("feature_1", "feature_2")) %>%
  left_join(cor_df_std, by = c("feature_1", "feature_2")) %>%
  mutate(
    rt_similarity = replace_na(rt_similarity, 0),
    cor_value = replace_na(cor_value, 0),
    EIC_similarity = replace_na(EIC_similarity, 0)
  )
```

### manually check EIC and cor vlaues


```{r}
#######################################################
# multi features EIC plot in one
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)


plot_multiple_EICs <- function(all_EIC_list, feature_indices) {
  
  combined_df <- lapply(feature_indices, function(i) {
    df <- all_EIC_list[[i]]$EIC_df
    df$sample <- rownames(df)              # rownames -> sample column
    df$feature <- paste0("Feature ", i)    # tag which feature it is
    df
  }) %>%
    bind_rows() %>%
    filter(!is.na(intensity) & intensity > 0)
  
  p <- ggplot(combined_df, aes(
    x = rt,
    y = intensity,  # log10(intensity),
    color = feature,
    group = feature      # connect points for each feature
  )) +
    geom_line() +
    geom_point(size = 1) +                 # add points to see each dot
    labs(
      title = paste("Overlayed EICs for Features", paste(feature_indices, collapse = ", ")),
      x = "Retention Time (rt)",
      y = "log10(Intensity)",
      color = "Feature"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()
  p
}
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(xgboost)
library(igraph)

```


```{r}
pu_semi_supervised <- function(data, features, label_col = "label",
                               n_bags = 30, prob_threshold = 0.4,
                               max_depth = 3, eta = 0.1, nrounds = 100) {
  # data: data frame with features and label
  # features: predictor column names
  # label_col: column with 1 (positive) and 0 (unlabeled)
  # n_bags: number of bagging iterations
  # prob_threshold: edge threshold for graph
  # max_depth, eta, nrounds: xgboost parameters
  
  # Extract predictors and labels
  predictors <- data %>% select(all_of(features))
  labels <- data[[label_col]]
  
  positives <- which(labels == 1)
  unlabeled <- which(labels == 0)
  
  dmat_all <- xgb.DMatrix(data = as.matrix(predictors))
  
  params <- list(
    objective = "binary:logistic",
    eval_metric = "auc",
    max_depth = max_depth,
    eta = eta,
    nthread = 2,
    verbosity = 0
  )
  
  # Matrix to store probabilities across bagging iterations
  pred_matrix <- matrix(0, nrow = nrow(data), ncol = n_bags)
  
  message("Starting PU bagging with ", n_bags, " iterations...")
  for (b in seq_len(n_bags)) {
    # Sample unlabeled examples as negatives
    sampled_unlabeled <- sample(unlabeled, length(positives), replace = FALSE)
    train_idx <- c(positives, sampled_unlabeled)
    
    train_labels <- ifelse(labels[train_idx] == 1, 1, 0)
    dtrain <- xgb.DMatrix(data = as.matrix(predictors[train_idx, ]), label = train_labels)
    
    # Train XGBoost model
    model <- xgb.train(params = params, data = dtrain, nrounds = nrounds, verbose = 0)
    
    # Predict probabilities on all data
    pred_matrix[, b] <- predict(model, dmat_all)
  }
  
  # Average probabilities
  pu_prob <- rowMeans(pred_matrix)
  
  # Add to data frame
  data$pu_prob <- pu_prob
  
  message("PU-learning finished. Building graph...")
  
  # Build graph based on threshold
  edges <- data %>%
    filter(pu_prob >= prob_threshold) %>%
    select(feature_1, feature_2, pu_prob)
  
  # Create graph (undirected)
  g <- graph_from_data_frame(edges, directed = FALSE)
  
  # Cluster features using Louvain
  clusters <- cluster_louvain(g)
  
  # Return list
  return(list(
    data = data,
    edges = edges,
    graph = g,
    clusters = clusters
  ))
}

```

```{r}
  label_col = "label",

)
```
